```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats believe Americans' right to vote is sacred and fundamental.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe it is necessary to stop corporations' outsized influence in elections.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will rectify the Supreme Court decision gutting the Voting Rights Act.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will stop efforts by Republican governors and legislatures to disenfranchise people of color, low-income people, and young people.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will prevent people of color, low-income people, and young people from being prevented from exercising their right to vote through onerous restrictions.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will ensure election officials comply with voting protections, including provisions mandating bilingual materials and voter assistance.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will fight to reform the campaign finance system.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party was founded on the promise of an expanded democracy.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The right to vote is at the heart of the Democratic Party's national vision.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Maximizing voter participation for all Americans is a core principle of the Democratic Party.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party believes it is necessary to make it easier to vote, not harder.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party's democracy suffers when nearly two thirds of citizens do not or cannot participate, as in the last midterm elections.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
